planner_json.title: Run every keyed harness through one adapter contract, recording the version it really installed
depends_on: GAW-11 (the stance with no write list and the claude-code node rule that this task's per-harness table carries forward)

write_prohibited: plugins/pixel-perfect/** - no plugin change in this task
test/harness/graders/** - E1 and E2 own grading
test/harness/stream/** - E1 and E4 to E8 own the tables
.github/workflows/harness-eval.yml - GAW-3 to GAW-9 own its edits
test/harness/smoke/observations.mjs - E2 and E3 own it
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/keyless-claude-load.description: The real claude CLI on the host, loaded keyless into a temp CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from this checkout
records: plugin details lists the 11 command names
no credential name in the child env

seed/real-child-capture.description: A real node child, run through createCapture and spawnCaptured, that prints 3 JSON lines, labelled with a harness and a version no table covers
records: capture.json and stdout.bin exist on disk for harness codex at version 0.0.0
5 rows: claude-code, codex, grok, opencode, pi

seed/real-case-manifests.description: The real case manifests in test/harness/cases, read through the case loader

specification.objective: Every keyed harness runs through one adapter contract in the shared cell loop, and each cell records the version its own track resolved plus four check rows that cite evidence.
specification.success_state: `runCell` and `installStep` get the adapter from the registry. A keyless claude-code leg through that loop yields 4 check rows, each citing a file on disk. A newest leg's `requested_cli_version` equals the version its track resolved. Five stance rows are the only runnable stances, and a keyless child holds no `_API_KEY` name.

requirements.description: GIVEN the real claude CLI loaded keyless into a temp config dir WHEN the adapter load runs with a resolved version equal to the host's `claude --version`, then with one a patch away THEN the first run's `requested_cli_version` equals `observed_cli_version` with `identity_decision.ok` true, and the second reads `installation-identity-mismatch` naming `observed_cli_version`
requirements.verification_service: real claude CLI loaded keyless into a temp config dir
requirements.positive_example: Resolved version equal to `claude --version` on the host: requested, resolved and observed all match and approveIdentity returns ok true.
requirements.red: On base executeLoad stamps pins.json 2.1.291 whatever the host reports, so with the host CLI at another version approveIdentity reads installation-identity-mismatch and this test fails.

scenario.verification_service: real claude CLI loaded keyless into a temp config dir

would_fail_if: executeLoad keeps a hard-coded pin
the resolved version is omitted from the call in install.mjs

examples: load.json identity with requested equal to observed

build_proof.range: anything that proves the identity a cell is approved against is the version its own track resolved
examples: install.mjs passing the resolved version to the adapter's load

steps: run the adapter load with the resolved version equal to the host `claude --version`
run it again with a resolved version one patch away

must_observe: first run: `requested_cli_version` equals `observed_cli_version` and identity_decision.ok is true
second run: reason `installation-identity-mismatch` naming field `observed_cli_version`
must_not_observe: requested_cli_version equal to the pin 2.1.291 when the track resolved another version
a null or empty observed_cli_version on the first run

requirements.description: GIVEN that keyless load with every credential removed WHEN `runCell` runs claude-code pinned and writes `cell.json`, and those per-check cells pass through `cellFor` again with `question_count`, `answers_delivered` and `stream_mapping` added THEN `checks` holds 4 rows in order, each citing a file on disk, `command_list` reads `pass`, the other 3 read `could-not-run` `missing-api-key`, and the added fields survive
requirements.verification_service: real claude CLI and the real capture, guard and cell writer
requirements.positive_example: A keyless claude-code leg: command_list passes on real plugin details bytes, and the three model checks read could-not-run missing-api-key, each citing its persisted refusal capture. The same per-check cells with question_count on a row and stream_mapping beside it keep both through cellFor.
requirements.red: On base cellFor copies only check_id, verdict, reason and source into checks, so every check has no evidence_paths and this test fails on the first check.

scenario.verification_service: real claude CLI and the real capture, guard and cell writer

would_fail_if: checks drop their evidence_paths
a refused invocation persists no capture, so its path list is empty
the loop keeps calling claudeCode directly for a harness the registry named
cellFor copies rows field by field, so question_count is omitted

build_proof.range: anything that proves every check of a keyed cell cites captured bytes that exist on disk and keeps every field its grader wrote

steps: run runCell for claude-code pinned with every credential removed and write cell.json
pass that run's per-check cells to cellFor again, with `question_count` 1 and `answers_delivered` 0 on one row and `stream_mapping` beside them

must_observe: `checks` has 4 rows in order command_list, status, verify, question_before_expensive_work
each row has at least 1 path in `evidence_paths` that resolves to a file on disk
command_list reads `pass`, and the other 3 read `could-not-run` with reason `missing-api-key`
the second cell's row keeps `question_count` 1 and `answers_delivered` 0, and the cell keeps `stream_mapping`
must_not_observe: a check with an empty evidence_paths array
any check reading pass on a model invocation that never started

requirements.description: GIVEN a parent env holding `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY1` and `GEMINI_API_KEY` set to a literal placeholder WHEN one keyless child and one keyed child bound to `GEMINI_API_KEY` start through `spawnCaptured` and print their env names THEN the keyless child prints 0 names matching `_API_KEY`, and the keyed child prints exactly `GEMINI_API_KEY`
requirements.verification_service: real child process started through spawnCaptured
requirements.positive_example: Parent env holding OPENROUTER_API_KEY=placeholder and XAI_API_KEY1=placeholder: the keyless child prints neither name, and a keyed child prints only its binding.
requirements.red: On base keylessEnv and childEnvFor match five named keys, so OPENROUTER_API_KEY reaches the child and this test reads its name in the child's printed env.

scenario.verification_service: real child process started through spawnCaptured

would_fail_if: the scrub stays a five-name regex
the scrub is removed, so the child env is unchanged from the parent

examples: the child's env names, values never printed

build_proof.range: anything that proves a graded or keyless child can only hold its own binding
examples: an allowlist for keyless steps and a pattern for keyed ones

steps: set OPENROUTER_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY1 and GEMINI_API_KEY to the literal placeholder in the parent env
start one keyless child and one keyed child with binding GEMINI_API_KEY, each printing its env names

must_observe: keyless child: 0 names matching `_API_KEY`
keyed child: exactly 1 such name, `GEMINI_API_KEY`
must_not_observe: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in either child
any secret value in the capture
an empty list of env names from either child

requirements.description: GIVEN the approved stance table WHEN each of the 5 rows is recorded, then recorded again carrying each of 7 rejected entries THEN each row is approved as the table states, and each rejected entry throws on 5 of 5 harnesses with `stance-mode-not-approved` for bypassPermissions and `stance-argv-not-approved` for the rest
requirements.unit_test_justified: UNIT_TEST_JUSTIFIED: the stance table is pure logic with zero I/O: an object in, a refusal or an approved argv out.
requirements.positive_example: The five rows are approved: claude-code and grok with Bash(node *), opencode with its permission rules, codex with its two sandboxes, pi with no-approval-gate. --trust, --auto, --always-approve, bypassPermissions, Bash(*), a bare Bash and a Write rule are each refused on every row.
requirements.red: On base recordStance refuses every mode but dontAsk and approves only the claude argv shape, so a codex row is refused and this test fails.

scenario.unit_test_justified: UNIT_TEST_JUSTIFIED: the stance table is pure logic with zero I/O.

would_fail_if: the table is a no-op that approves any stance
a harness with no approved row is omitted from the refusal path
the node rule check is removed, so Bash(*) is admitted

build_proof.range: anything that proves each harness can run only its approved row, and that a wider Bash rule or a write rule cannot appear on any harness

steps: record the approved row for each of the 5 harnesses
record each row again carrying each of --trust, --auto, --always-approve, bypassPermissions, `Bash(*)`, `Bash` and `Write(reports/verify-button-drift.json)`

must_observe: the claude-code and grok argv each hold `Bash(node *)`
opencode's OPENCODE_PERMISSION allows `node *`, denies `*`, and denies edit
codex status holds `read-only`, codex verify holds `workspace-write`, and pi reads `no-approval-gate`
each of the 7 rejected entries throws on 5 of 5 harnesses: reason `stance-mode-not-approved` for bypassPermissions, reason `stance-argv-not-approved` for the rest
must_not_observe: an approved stance holding a `Write(` rule
a harness with no row reading approved by default

`evidence_paths` holds 1 path ending `.capture.json` that resolves on disk

split_check.kept_because: Tried cutting the identity fix from the dispatch change. They cross the same two calls: install.mjs must ask the registry for the adapter and pass that adapter the track's resolved version, so a cut leaves one half unable to run. Stance is one small table only this record touches, and every adapter imports it with the contract.
